packaged_windows_gui.scope: Automated offscreen qualification of a relocated, fully frozen Windows x64 GUI and its compiled console worker, with two independent GUI launches.
limitations: The hosted runner has Python installed for the generated PYZ runtime.
This is not a manual interactive Windows 11 test or a clean machine without Python.

scope_note: Completes gui.windows-test for 3 points: a relocated Windows x64 Maxkompilator.exe, real compiled CLI workers, full GUI workflow, readable ASCII and Polish text, clean closure and an independent second launch. Clean Windows without Python, manual interactive Windows 11 release qualification, Android SDK/device builds and real .NET publishing remain separate gates.

visual_review.method: Inspected both screenshots downloaded from the successful Windows qualification artifact.
findings: Readable labels, input fields, buttons, output summary and build logs, including Polish text.
The vivid 3D PNG is present in the actual packaged Windows window.
The screenshot records an actual PYZ build and runtime result.

screenshot.scope: Actual relocated Windows x64 Maxkompilator.exe after a successful GUI-driven build and runtime check, captured with Qt offscreen.

superseded_run.reason: The initial Windows offscreen screenshots contained missing-glyph boxes. Progress was held at 55 until host font registration and mandatory per-control glyph validation passed in the current run.
